resumen: Standing facing a low pulley, you raise a short bar by bending the elbows. Like a barbell curl, but the resistance pulls in the direction of the cable.
ejecucion: Grip the low pulley bar with your palms up, shoulder-width apart, and step back.
Stand with your elbows by your sides and your arms straight.
Curl the bar up by bending your elbows, without your elbows moving forward or your torso leaning back.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.
If your elbow moves forward or your torso swings to lift, the weight is too heavy.
matices: There are no studies of the standing cable curl as such. In the preacher curl, ten weeks with a cable or a barbell gave similar biceps growth, although the cable loads the end of the range more and the barbell the start.

fuentes.titulo: Placing Greater Torque at Shorter or Longer Muscle Lengths? Effects of Cable vs. Barbell Preacher Curl Training on Muscular Strength and Hypertrophy in Young Adults
